schemes.definition: A flaw or weakness in software, hardware, or a system that can be exploited to compromise security.
A program, application, operating system, or software component designed for end users or computing systems.
A company or organization that develops, manufactures, or supplies software, hardware, or technology services.
A sovereign nation, state, or distinct territorial body with its own government.
An official institution, ministry, department, or administrative body operating under the authority of a national or regional government.
Software, code, or executable files intentionally designed to disrupt, damage, or gain unauthorized access to computer systems or data.
A standardized web address identifying the location of a specific resource or endpoint on a computer network.
An individual human being, such as a government official, cybersecurity professional, diplomat, or other public figure.
A numerical label assigned to a device or network interface to identify its location on a computer network.
A unique identifier used to send and receive electronic mail messages over a computer network.
A digital file, script, document, or archive stored on a filesystem or transmitted across a network.
A commercial business, corporation, or enterprise operating within a specific industry or market.
A unique identification string that defines a realm of administrative autonomy, authority, or control within the Internet.
An individual or organized group responsible for conducting malicious cyber activities, attacks, or espionage campaigns.
